product_metadata.title: LINKChef Food Chopper Electric, 5 Cup Mini Food Processor Stainless Steel, Small Meat Grinder with 4 Bi-Level Blades, Kitchen Cutter for Vegetable, Onion, Garlic, Meat, Nuts
features: 【5 Cup Mini Food Processor】Powerful 5 Cup mini Chopper allows you chopping, blending, pureeing, mixing and mincing a variety of food quickly in kitchen, suitable for Vegetable, Onion, Garlic, Salad, Baby Food, Ice, Fruit, Nuts, Potato and so on.

【304 Stainless Steel-Sturdy & Safe】All parts of our meat grinder are made of stainless steel/BPA-free, ensure the safety of you and your family's daily meals. The handle is designed to fit your hand, allowing you to more easily and safely use.

【Fast and Efficient Chopper】Our food processor uses a 250W pure copper motor, the pure copper motor can bring faster speed and lower motor temperature under the same power, 4D sharp blades can crush food evenly in 360 degrees, making it easier for you cooking.

【Precise Control】Pulsing button for ultimate control provide precise control to produce perfect texture of your ingredients - ideal for anything such as creating a meat stuffing, vegetable salad and tomato ketchup.

【Easy to Use & Clean】Stainless steel food chopper resist to scratch and corrosion, compact and lightweight, perfect size of this meat grinder electric for everyday use in the kitchen, dishwasher-safe. 7*24h friendly customer service.
